title: Revert binding
description: The binding text basalt_meta.prepare_revert, rescope_revert and reset_revert build, in the text rules of CONTRACT.md, Stores, Text rules. The WebAuthn challenge is sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Clients parse it for display and never re-serialise it. Owner decision RS-3: the scope is carried as scope descriptors (select, proposed). See CONTRACT.md, Revert.

store.description: Which store wrote the binding: its kind and the name it gives what the agent is bound to (current_database() in Postgres), for display. Not the reserved store key of the descriptor (RS-4).

select.description: The scope the person signs: the agent's proposal, or the person's rescope of it.

proposed.description: What the requesting agent proposed. Omitted when it equals select, which is every revert nobody rescoped.

widened.description: True when select covers any change not made by requestedBy (its agents is null or names another agent).

agentRows.description: Present exactly when widened is true: lines per agent whose changes the select covers, RESTORE and SKIP, keyed agent:<name>, for the page's headline.

intent.description: Why the person reverts; recorded as the revert change's intent.

rows.description: RESTORE lines. With rows plus skipped over 1000 the plan is batched. 0 only for a task proposal with no line of the agent's own (a revert that cannot be signed until the person widens it; apply_revert answers NOTHING_TO_REVERT).

rowsHash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of every line, RESTORE and SKIP, joined by a newline.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC with microseconds, 1 hour after prepare_revert, or after the latest rescope or reset.

requestedBy.description: The agent that called prepare_revert, agent:<name>; lines are redacted for it. For a batched plan, the only agent that may apply it.

batched.description: Present only on a large plan (more than 1000 lines): the agent applies it in batches of up to 200 lines within 24 hours of the signature.

sampleHash.description: Present only with batched: lowercase hex sha256 of the sample (CONTRACT.md, Large plans) joined by a newline. The revert request carries the sample.

kind.description: The store's kind (CONTRACT.md, Stores). A page uses it as a label only.

name.description: The name the store gives what the agent is bound to: current_database() in Postgres.

agentName.description: An agent, agent:<name> with <name> its name in engine.json; never the store's login for it (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Agent names).
